There’s a perfect balance of theory and practice, which really deepens the understanding of yoga beyond the mat.
We also got opportunities to lead classes gradually, and the feedback we received helped us understand our strengths and areas to work on. After finishing the main course, Neha Ma’am spent extra time helping us revise for the exam, clear our doubts, and feel confident about teaching, understanding health conditions, and guiding students safely. I never felt rushed, she is incredibly supportive, patient, and friendly.

I’m truly grateful for this experience. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a nice, in-depth, and heart-centered TTC.
